title: Keyboard for mobile!!
features: This script works for mobile players: it has a full keyboard that is similar to a regular real keyboard, and you can walk, jump, etc.
script:
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local VirtualInputManager = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local Player = Players.LocalPlayer

pcall(function()
    StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.Chat, true)
end)

if CoreGui:FindFirstChild("MobileKeyboard") then
    CoreGui.MobileKeyboard:Destroy()
end

local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "MobileKeyboard"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ScreenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
ScreenGui.Parent = CoreGui

local function makeDraggable(guiObject)
    local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos

    guiObject.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos = guiObject.Position
            
            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    dragging = false
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    guiObject.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
            dragInput = input
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input == dragInput and dragging then
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart
            guiObject.Position = UDim2.new(
                startPos.X.Scale, 
                startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, 
                startPos.Y.Scale, 
                startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
            )
        end
    end)
end

ToggleButton.Name = "CenterToggleBtn"

local UICornerBtn = Instance.new("UICorner")

makeDraggable(ToggleButton)

local KeyboardFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
KeyboardFrame.Name = "FullKeyboardPanel"
KeyboardFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 680, 0, 210)
KeyboardFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -340, 0, 65)
KeyboardFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 25)
KeyboardFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0

KeyboardFrame.ZIndex = 99
KeyboardFrame.Active = true
KeyboardFrame.Parent = ScreenGui

local FrameCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
FrameCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
FrameCorner.Parent = KeyboardFrame

makeDraggable(KeyboardFrame)

local function createKey(name, text, keyCode, sizeX, sizeY, posX, posY)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Name = name
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, sizeX, 0, sizeY)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, posX, 0, posY)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55)
    btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    btn.Text = text
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    btn.TextSize = 11
    btn.ZIndex = 100
    btn.Active = true
    btn.Parent = KeyboardFrame
    
    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
    corner.Parent = btn
    
    if keyCode then
        btn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
            pcall(function()
                VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(true, keyCode, false, game)
            end)
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 200, 100)
        end)
        
        btn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
            pcall(function()
                VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, keyCode, false, game)
            end)
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55)
        end)
        
        btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            pcall(function()
                VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, keyCode, false, game)
            end)
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55)
        end)
    end
    return btn
end

local StickZone = Instance.new("TextButton")
StickZone.Name = "StickTouchZone"
StickZone.Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 120)
StickZone.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 1, -135)
StickZone.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
StickZone.BackgroundTransparency = 0
StickZone.BorderSizePixel = 0

StickZone.Active = true
StickZone.ZIndex = 99
StickZone.Parent = ScreenGui

local StickZoneCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
StickZoneCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
StickZoneCorner.Parent = StickZone

local StickKnob = Instance.new("Frame")
StickKnob.Name = "Knob"
StickKnob.Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 40)
StickKnob.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -20, 0.5, -20)
StickKnob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
StickKnob.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
StickKnob.BorderSizePixel = 0
StickKnob.ZIndex = 101
StickKnob.Parent = StickZone

local StickKnobCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
StickKnobCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
StickKnobCorner.Parent = StickKnob

local activeInput = nil
local knobCenter = Vector2.new(60, 60)
local maxDist = 35

local function resetMovement()
    activeInput = nil
    StickKnob.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -20, 0.5, -20)
    pcall(function()
        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.W, false, game)
        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.S, false, game)
        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.A, false, game)
        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.D, false, game)
    end)
end

StickZone.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) and not activeInput then
        activeInput = input
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input == activeInput then
        resetMovement()
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == activeInput and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) then
        local absPos = StickZone.AbsolutePosition
        local touchPos = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
        local relPos = touchPos - absPos - knobCenter
        
        if relPos.Magnitude > maxDist then
            relPos = relPos.Unit * maxDist
        end
        
        StickKnob.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, relPos.X - 20, 0.5, relPos.Y - 20)
        
        pcall(function()
            VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(relPos.Y < -8, Enum.KeyCode.W, false, game)
            VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(relPos.Y > 8, Enum.KeyCode.S, false, game)
            VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(relPos.X < -8, Enum.KeyCode.A, false, game)
            VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(relPos.X > 8, Enum.KeyCode.D, false, game)
        end)
    end
end)

JumpButton.Parent = ScreenGui

local JumpCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
JumpCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
JumpCorner.Parent = JumpButton

local isHoldingJump = false

JumpButton.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
    isHoldingJump = true
end)

JumpButton.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
    isHoldingJump = false
end)

JumpButton.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
    isHoldingJump = false
end)

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        if isHoldingJump then
            local char = Player.Character
            if char then
                local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if humanoid and humanoid:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running then
                    humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
                end
            end
        end
        task.wait(0.1)
    end
end)

local isOpen = false
ToggleButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    isOpen = not isOpen
    KeyboardFrame.Visible = isOpen
    ToggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = isOpen and Color3.fromRGB(50, 200, 100) or Color3.fromRGB(80, 150, 255)
end)
